apple.body: iCloud has no public calendar API, and we will never ask you for an app-specific password. Use the ICS subscription (Apple Calendar refreshes it hourly or faster) or, if your Microsoft account is on the device, connect Microsoft 365: the classes then appear in the native Calendar app.

feed.title: ICS subscription
feed.subject: Subject
feed.includeColleagues: Include classes taught by colleagues on my subjects
feed.googleWarning: Google Calendar re-reads subscriptions every 8 to 24 hours and there is no way to hurry it. For same-day changes, connect Google Calendar with the button above.

steps.apple: Calendar → File → New Calendar Subscription → paste the address → Refresh: every hour.
steps.google: Google Calendar → Other calendars → + → From URL → paste the address.
steps.outlook: Outlook → Calendar → Add calendar → Subscribe from web → paste the address.
steps.thunderbird: Thunderbird → New Calendar → On the Network → iCalendar (ICS) → paste the address.

errors.notConfigured: This calendar provider is not configured.
errors.connectFailed: The connection could not be completed.

install.title: Install UAcademic
install.why: Installed it opens like an app, runs faster, and your timetable can be read with no connection.
install.offline: Your timetable stays available even where there is no signal.

ios.share: Tap Safari’s Share button, in the bottom bar.
ios.add: Choose "Add to Home Screen" and confirm.
ios.push: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only arrive once the app is on the home screen.

offline.title: Offline
offline.calendar: Showing the last timetable saved on this device. It will refresh once you are back online.
offline.generic: There is no connection right now. What you see may be out of date.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: What we hold about you, for how long, and what you can do about it.

export.title: Download your data
export.hint: One file with everything the platform holds about you: profile, timetable, messages, notifications and assistant conversations.
export.excluded: No keys or tokens are included, deliberately: neither the calendar credentials nor the ICS subscription token.

erasure.title: Erase your account
erasure.hint: You ask, and the center’s administration carries it out. Not instant, and better that way: erasing an account mid-semester would leave classes without anybody responsible for them.
erasure.requested: Request recorded. The center’s administration will be in touch.
erasure.keptWhy: The academic record and the audit trail are kept: a center has to be able to say who approved what. You remain there as an anonymous account, not as yourself.

ai.title: Use of artificial intelligence
ai.body: The assistant sends Anthropic the text of the question, the center’s regulatory documents and organisational data with names and internal identifiers. Never an identity document, phone number, address, bank details or anything medical. It writes nothing without a person confirming it, and every exchange is recorded.

activities.title: Record of processing activities
activities.hint: What is processed, why, on what basis and for how long.
activities.noContact: The center has not published a data protection contact yet.

recipients.none: None: the center’s own server only

identity.title: Identity and access
identity.purpose: Authenticating people and knowing which role they hold in each center.
identity.basis: Performance of an employment or service relationship, and the center’s legitimate interest.

teaching.title: Teaching commitment
teaching.purpose: Comparing contracted capacity with assigned teaching.
teaching.basis: Legal obligation and performance of the contract.

availability.title: Availability
availability.purpose: Planning timetables that respect when each person can teach.
availability.basis: Performance of the contract, and consent for syncing with external calendars.

schedule.title: Timetable and changes
schedule.purpose: Publishing the timetable and handling class changes and absences.
schedule.basis: Legal obligation and legitimate interest in organising teaching.

communication.title: Communication
communication.purpose: Internal messages and notifications about changes that affect you.
communication.basis: Legitimate interest; push notifications with the browser’s consent.

calendar.title: External calendar
calendar.purpose: Publishing your timetable into the calendar you actually use.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.purpose: Answering coordination questions about timetables, load and regulations.
assistant.basis: The center’s legitimate interest; usage is recorded and nothing is applied without human confirmation.

audit.title: Audit and consents
audit.purpose: Being able to say who made each change and when each consent was given.
audit.basis: Legal obligation and legitimate interest in traceability.

installer.title: Install UAcademic
installer.subtitle: Four steps. Nothing is written until the last one.
installer.checking: Checking the state of the installation…

already.title: Already installed
already.body: This installation already has a configuration. To change it, edit the .env file on the server and restart the process.

token.title: Installation token
token.hint: The server wrote one into shared/install.token and printed it in the log at start-up. Copy it here: this is what keeps the installer to whoever has access to the server.
token.label: Token

database.title: MySQL database
database.hint: Create it first with utf8mb4 and grant a user of its own full privileges. The installer does not create the database: it creates the tables.
database.name: Database name
database.hasTables: Careful: this database already holds tables. If they are from an earlier installation, the migrations will be applied on top of them.
database.charsetWarning: The recommended character set is utf8mb4. With another, accents and emoji can break.

site.title: Address and center
site.urlHint: With https and no trailing slash. This is what the links in notifications will carry.
site.entraHint: Leave them empty to sign in with the local administrator account and configure Microsoft Entra ID later.

admin.title: Platform administrator
admin.hint: This account holds the SUPERADMIN role and a local password for getting in when Microsoft Entra ID is unavailable.
admin.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Keep it in a password manager: it is not shown again.

done.title: Installed
done.body: Restart the API process so it reads the new configuration, and you can sign in.
done.next: Next: register the Microsoft tenants, create the academic year, and upload the center’s regulation.

errors.databaseUnreachable: The database server could not be reached.
errors.databaseAccess: The user or password is wrong, or the user lacks privileges.
errors.databaseMissing: That database does not exist. Create it first.
errors.migrationsFailed: The tables could not be created. Check that the user has CREATE and ALTER privileges.
errors.bootstrapFailed: The center and administrator could not be created.
errors.configurationFailed: The configuration file could not be written. Check the directory permissions.

images.photoHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, up to 4 MB.
images.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, up to 4 MB.

errors.unsupportedType: That image format is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF.
errors.tooLarge: The image is too large. The maximum is 4 MB.
